scope: Original fretless diagrams and factual fingering metadata; teacher videos are embedded only on request. No recordings, photographs or third-party lyrics are copied.

fingering.source: https://ks-sanshin.com/三線の勘所とは？初心者が押さえられるようにな/
fingering.credit: 栗山新也 沖縄三線教室: 勘所と基本の運指を確認。図・文章はMusic Stackが新たに作成。
fingering.mapping: 乙・上・五=index; 老・中・六=middle; 尺・七・八=little. 九 extends the little-finger position toward the body. 尺 has low/high variants. Positions are proportional pitch-based illustrations, not measured distances or a universal school-specific fingering.

tinsagu.attribution: Kunkunshi for Tinsagu nu Hana, Lrschneider (2017), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Adaptation by Music Stack.
tinsagu.changes: First verse with surrounding instrumental phrase. Transcribed the large symbols right-to-left, top-to-bottom; omitted small ornamental notes, set each cell to one beat at 85 BPM in C-F-C honchoshi. Retains the one-cell rest. 63 notes across 64 beats. This adapted MIDI and the note data in build-practice-sanshin.mjs retain CC BY-SA 4.0; application code is separate. No lyrics or source image are bundled.
